stories.headline: Google drops Gemini 4 Carbon, its strongest model yet
stories.summary: Released Tuesday afternoon; Ultra subscribers and paying API customers get it first, and Cursor puts it top of CursorBench at 60.4%.

stories.headline: Anthropic's IPO roadshow opens with a $70–$78 price range
stories.summary: Nasdaq listing under ticker ANT, implying a ~$1.4T valuation; seven tech giants have committed $26B alongside the offering.

stories.headline: GTA 6 preloads are live — and it'll stream on Xbox Cloud Gaming at launch
stories.summary: Launches Nov 19 on PS5/Xbox; cloud streaming starts 1 AM ET on launch day for Series X|S and even Xbox One, but not PC.

stories.headline: GTA VI Festival tickets go on sale today in Miami
stories.summary: Nov 21 at Mana Wynwood; lottery codes unlock ticket sales at noon today, $60 tickets, two per code.

stories.headline: Russia–Ukraine talks wrap in Abu Dhabi with a big prisoner swap agreed
stories.summary: Zelenskyy called day one "constructive and quite substantive"; officials say both sides agreed a large POW exchange as the two-day talks close.

stories.headline: Millions strike in Spain over the housing crisis
stories.summary: The country's first general strike in 14 years, demanding action on soaring housing costs.

stories.headline: 'Madden' hits select theaters today, streaming Nov 18
stories.summary: David O. Russell's film stars Nicolas Cage as John Madden; Memphis musician Scott Bomar contributed music.
